name: nerpacad
description: NerpaCad — простая 3D CAD-система и симулятор робототехники для детей

scripts.dev: npm run deps && npm run ensure-electron && electron-vite dev
scripts.preview: npm run deps && npm run ensure-electron && electron-vite preview
scripts.test:e2e: npm run deps && npm run ensure-electron && electron-vite build && playwright test
scripts.build:win: npm run deps && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: npm run deps && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
